head: 61aeb72

identity.defect: Login verifies credentials before its transaction and issueSession never revalidates under the user row lock, so a concurrent reset-password commit lets an in-flight old-password login insert a valid session

findings.dispositionReason: Race verified by reading Login/issueSession/ResetPassword lock ordering; violates the spec'd hygiene rule that reset revokes every session immediately.
evidence: auth/commands.go Login: loadUserByEmail + verifyPassword run before issueSession
users/governance.go ResetPassword: loadUserForUpdate (FOR UPDATE) then UPDATE password_hash then DELETE sessions
issueSession tx inserts session without rechecking status/password_hash under lock

identity.source: contracts/identity.yaml q maxLength:256 (OpenAPI maxLength counts characters)
identity.defect: len(q) counts UTF-8 bytes, so a contract-valid multibyte search (e.g. 100 CJK characters) is rejected with invalid_search

findings.dispositionReason: OpenAPI 3.1 maxLength is defined over characters; byte counting rejects contract-valid input.

identity.defect: Display-name validation counts raw UTF-8 bytes before trimming, rejecting contract-valid multibyte names and long whitespace-only values that the contract says derive from the email

findings.dispositionReason: Same OpenAPI character semantics as CR-STANDARDS-0002; normalize-then-validate is the documented contract behavior.
evidence: governance.go Validate: len(r.DisplayName) > maxDisplayNameLength before any trim
governance.go Create: strings.TrimSpace(req.DisplayName) derives the default only after validation

identity.anchor: contracts/identity.yaml: management user schema inlined at create/list/disable/reset/email/role responses
identity.defect: The management-user shape is copied six times, so a field change risks contract drift

findings.dispositionReason: Deliberate tradeoff: the contract conformance harness resolves $ref pointers only against the master document, so module-local refs would silently skip required-field checks. Dedupe after the harness learns module-internal resolution.
evidence: identity/integrationtest/contract_conformance_test.go resolveRef uses the master spec map for every $ref

identity.source: #102 acceptance: 删除仅对从未登录过的账号放行
identity.defect: Migration 0002 leaves last_login_at NULL for every pre-existing user, so accounts that logged in under baseline v1 become deletable after upgrade

findings.dispositionReason: Up-only migrations must hold the never-logged-in invariant across the v1→v2 upgrade, not only on fresh databases; backfill from session and audit evidence is cheap and exact.
evidence: 0002 adds the column with no backfill
baseline v1 deployments carry users with sessions and session_created audit rows that the column would ignore

identity.source: #102 acceptance: 重置密码吊销该用户全部会话
identity.defect: Spec-axis twin of CR-STANDARDS-0001: an old-password login in flight across a reset-password commit survives as a valid session

findings.dispositionReason: Same defect observed against the spec criterion; repaired together with CR-STANDARDS-0001.
evidence: ResetPassword revokes sessions and swaps the hash in one transaction
issueSession neither locks nor revalidates the credential it was verified against

identity.source: #102 acceptance: 末位 admin 保护、门禁与可见性规则均有 Seam A 集成测试
identity.defect: Member rejection (RequireAdmin 403) is asserted only for create and email; disable, reset-password, role, and delete have no member-gate Seam A assertion

findings.dispositionReason: An accidentally mis-guarded governance route would pass the current suite; the criterion demands gate coverage at Seam A.
evidence: member 403 asserted in TestCreateUserIssuesAccountWithInitialPassword and TestChangeEmailMovesTheLoginIdentifier only

identity.source: #102 acceptance: 治理写操作在同一写事务内写入审计行
identity.defect: Audit-mutation atomicity is never behaviorally forced: no test makes the audit insert fail and asserts the mutation rolled back

findings.dispositionReason: Success-path audit rows and the failed-create no-row case are covered; a forced audit-failure injection (revoking INSERT mid-test) is a worthwhile hardening test deferred to the test-stack follow-up (#106).
evidence: tests assert audit rows on success and absence after duplicate-email failure (pre-mutation failure)
no path exercises a failing audit write after a successful mutation

hunks: issueSession: locked recheck of status + password_hash before session insert (CR-STANDARDS-0001, CR-SPEC-0002)
TestGovernanceRoutesRejectMembers table test over all six governance routes (CR-SPEC-0003)
deterministic stale-credential issuance test; v1→v2 backfill upgrade test; multibyte unit tests
